name: Shin Nippon Air Technologies
summary: Shin Nippon Air Technologies Co., Ltd., along with its affiliated companies, offers specialized engineering solutions for managing environmental conditions, encompassing air, water, and temperature control. These services extend to air conditioning, electrical systems, and sanitary infrastructure across diverse facilities, both in Japan and globally. Their core expertise includes comprehensive air conditioning systems tailored for a wide array of establishments, such as corporate offices, retail centers, healthcare facilities, hotels, and cultural institutions. Moreover, the company develops sophisticated industrial environments, including precision clean rooms and climate-controlled spaces essential for sectors like semiconductor manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, and research and development centers. They also participate in the construction of large-scale district heating and cooling networks. Established in 1930, Shin Nippon Air Technologies Co., Ltd. operates from its headquarters in Tokyo, Japan.
